messages:
Olivia.AE: Heads up — NovaExchange POC starts next week. They need SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM provisioning (bulk + delta), RBAC mapping, and strong domain ownership controls. Also flagged KMS/HSM + key rotation. Can we summarize what we support and any limits?
Sam.Eng: We do SAML 2.0 (IdP/SP init), support common attributes (email, givenName, familyName, groups). Attribute mapping to user fields and groups->roles mapping is supported. Default session TTL is 1h but configurable per-tenant.
Leo.Solutions: SCIM: SCIM 2.0 for users and groups, delta tokens supported, bulk endpoint for initial bootstrap. Hosted: soft throttle ~200 req/min; Dedicated can raise this via capacity/throughput config. SCIM changes are eventual-consistent — expect short lag on large syncs.
Arjun.Sales: Pricing question — do we bill per-provisioning call for hosted customers? Need clear quote language for the commercial.
Olivia.AE: For Enterprise deals we usually roll provisioning into Dedicated reserved capacity + an onboarding provisioning bundle for very large syncs. For hosted self-serve, very high-volume provisioning can trigger a provisioning add-on. @Sam.Eng to confirm thresholds.
Sam.Eng: Confirm — we don’t surface a per-call charge for Dedicated. For hosted, provisioning add-on kicks in beyond ~100k sync operations/month (approx); exact threshold and pricing table TBD with pricing ops. I’ll get a concrete number.
SecurityBot: Security note from questionnaire: customer requires KMS integration, SAML assertions signed with SHA-256, and periodic signing key rotation. We support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) on Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted supports managed keys but can offer CMEK for enterprise contracts.
LegalOps: Domain proofing: we support DNS TXT verification and verification via admin email to domain owners. For multi-tenant setups across subdomains we map domains to tenants; we can also restrict sign-ins by domain allowlist.
Leo.Solutions: RBAC details: role templates + custom roles available. Groups synced via SCIM can be mapped to roles. Nested groups are flattened on import (we return group membership list). We can export sample role mapping JSON for their engineers.
Arjun.Sales: They asked about SSO failover — if Dedicated nodes have an outage, can we route to hosted fallback?
Sam.Eng: Yes, routing policy supports fallback to a compatible hosted model (read-only for any in-flight stateful ops until full recovery). Requires a canary/fallback policy set in the Console; document the runbook for failover/fallback.
Olivia.AE: Action items: 1) Sam — confirm hosted provisioning threshold and add-on pricing (reply here). 2) Leo — prepare a 1-pager with sample SCIM payloads + role mapping JSON. 3) LegalOps/SecurityBot — confirm KMS/rotation text we can share in the security questionnaire. I’ll schedule a pre-POC call Wed 10:00 PT, 30m. Can you join?
Sam.Eng: :thumbsup: I can join Wed 10:00 PT. I’ll bring SCIM rate numbers and fallback runbook.
Leo.Solutions: I can join Wed 10:00 PT. I’ll attach role mapping examples and a sample SCIM bulk payload to the invite.
Olivia.AE: Thanks — I’ll send calendar invite and include the SAML/SCIM quickstart links and the security checklist. cc: novaexchange-sec@customer.com
